name: interview-evidence-platform
description: Contract-first monorepo for the Interview Evidence Platform.

scripts.format: prettier --write . && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-sync ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-sync ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: eslint . && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-sync ruff check .
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-sync pytest
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-sync mypy backend/src
scripts.test:workspace: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
